自建应用消息、自定义交互按钮、原生卡片、接收回调、菜单、工作台、身份与审批集成: Custom app messages, configurable action buttons, native cards, incoming callbacks, menus, workbench, identity, and approval integrations
企业微信管理后台 → 我的企业 → 企业信息 → 企业 ID: WeCom admin console → My Company → Company Information → Corporate ID
应用管理 → 自建应用 → AgentId；接收成员须在应用可见范围内: App Management → Custom App → AgentId; recipients must be within the app's visibility scope
同一自建应用的 Secret；请配置插件服务器的企业可信 IP: The Secret for the same custom app; add the plugin server's IP address to the corporate trusted IP list
应用管理 → 接收消息 → 设置 API 接收；仅接收回调和自动回复需要: App Management → Receive Messages → Set Up API Reception; required only for incoming callbacks and automatic replies
与企业微信 API 接收配置一致的 43 位密钥；仅接收回调和自动回复需要: The 43-character key matching the WeCom API reception settings; required only for incoming callbacks and automatic replies
全部收件人已被接口接受: All recipients accepted by the API
点击卡片进入网页，不是微信消息内的原生交互卡片: Opens a web page when clicked; this is not a native interactive card inside a WeChat message
普通微信通过链接打开网页并点击自定义按钮；动作和回传值由工作流定义，不内置业务状: WeChat users open a linked web page and click custom buttons. The workflow defines actions and callback values; no business state machine is built in
纯文字，1 至 16384 字节；消息摘要会截短，网页保留全文: Plain text, 1 to 16384 bytes; the message preview is truncated, while the web page retains the full text
1 至 8 个按钮；只声明展示文字、动作标识与回传对象，业务处理由工作流完成: 1 to 8 buttons defining display text, action IDs, and callback objects; the workflow handles the business logic
同一消息内唯一，1 至 64 位字母、数字、下划线或连字符；例如 approve: Unique within the message; 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, such as approve or reject
1 至 40 个字符；例如同意发布、退回修改: 1 to 40 characters, such as Approve release or Request changes
自定义 JSON 对象，原样进入 interaction_action.acti: A custom JSON object passed unchanged to interaction_action.action_value; do not include passwords or secrets
所有按钮共用的 JSON 对象，原样进入事件 context；与所有按钮 val: A JSON object shared by all buttons and passed unchanged to the event context; its combined size with all button value objects must not exceed 16 KiB
可选，最长 256 字节；同应用重复键和相同内容返回已有消息，不填则每次创建新消: Optional, up to 256 bytes. Reusing the same key and content within the same app returns the existing message. Leaving it empty creates a new message each time; it is independent of business identifiers
复制本插件凭证的完整 HTTPS Webhook 地址，用于网页与身份授权回调: Copy the full HTTPS webhook URL for this plugin credential; it hosts the web page and receives identity authorization callbacks
1 至 4 个字符；网页中的按钮由 buttons 单独定义: 1 to 4 characters; the web page's action buttons are defined separately in buttons
1 至 720 小时；到期后不可再操作: 1 to 720 hours; actions are disabled after expiration
查询消息内容、最近动作和动作序号；不推断内部系统的业务处理结果: Retrieve the message content, latest action, and action sequence number; this does not determine the outcome of processing in the business system
发送时保存的自定义 JSON 对象: The custom JSON object saved when the message was sent
核验凭证对应应用和本地存储，不发送消息；不代表成员可见范围和微信插件已配置: Verify the credential's app and local storage without sending messages; this does not confirm the app's member visibility scope or WeChat integration settings
普通微信不支持 markdown、小程序通知或模板卡片；body 不得覆盖收件人: WeChat does not support Markdown, mini program notifications, or template cards; body must not override recipients or app identity
企业微信原生对象；多种消息或模板类型拥有不同嵌套字段，详见插件文档: A native WeCom object; nested fields vary by message or template type. See the plugin documentation
仅企业微信客户端支持；按钮点击通过 application_event 回调，普: Supported only in the WeCom client; button clicks arrive through application_event. For WeChat, use Send interactive message
企业微信 template_card 对象本身，无需再包 template_ca: The WeCom template_card object itself, without an additional template_card wrapper; includes official fields such as card_type, task_id, and button_list
仅企业微信；response_code 有效 72 小时且一次有效，请保存返回的: WeCom only; response_code is valid for 72 hours and can be used once. Retain the returned members whose updates failed
原生 button 或 template_card 二选一；不同卡片类型拥有不同: Provide either a native button or template_card object; fields vary by card type
仅撤回 24 小时内的企业微信消息；普通微信不支持撤回: Recall only WeCom messages sent within the last 24 hours; WeChat does not support recall
media_id 有效期 3 天；图片或视频≤10MB，AMR 语音≤2MB且≤: media_id is valid for 3 days; images or videos must be at most 10 MB, AMR voice at most 2 MB and 60 seconds, and files at most 20 MB
企业微信原生响应；字段随应用设置、菜单及工作台模板类型变化: A native WeCom response; fields vary by app settings, menu, and workbench template type
只支持官方应用设置字段；应用身份取自凭证: Supports only official app settings fields; app identity comes from the credential
覆盖当前应用菜单，最多 3 个一级菜单，每项最多 5 个子菜单: Replace the current app menu with up to 3 top-level entries, each containing up to 5 submenu entries
原生 button 数组；菜单层级和 click、view、小程序等按钮字段不同: A native button array; fields vary by menu level and button type, such as click, view, or mini program
需先在管理后台启用工作台自定义展示，仅企业微信客户端生效: Enable custom workbench display in the admin console first; applies only to the WeCom client
显式成员列表与原生 type、对应类型内容；仅企业微信客户端生效: Provide an explicit member list, the native type, and content for that type; applies only to the WeCom client
用于业务页面接入 JS-SDK；仅在已认证的业务服务中调用，前端不接触 Secr: Connect business web pages to the JS-SDK; call only from an authenticated backend service so the frontend never receives the Secret
业务系统保存随机 state，并在接收 code 时核对后再交换身份: The business system must save a random state and verify it when receiving code, before exchanging the code for the user's identity
用授权 code 获取成员身份: Exchange authorization code for member identity
code 一次有效；业务系统必须先验证登录回调 state: The code can be used once; the business system must first verify the login callback state
需在审批应用的可调用接口应用中授权本自建应用: Authorize this custom app in the Approval app's list of apps allowed to call its APIs
审批模板控件和多语言字段因表单而异，按官方原生结构传入: Approval template controls and multilingual fields vary by form; provide the official native structure
会实际提交审批；需审批应用授权和对应模板权限: Submits an actual approval request; requires authorization from the Approval app and permission for the selected template
原生 creator_userid、template_id、审批人规则与各类型控: Native creator_userid, template_id, approver rules, and apply_data for the relevant control types
时间跨度不超过 31 天，最多 100 条；下一页传 body.new_curs: A time span of at most 31 days and up to 100 results; pass body.new_cursor for the next page
原生 starttime、endtime、size、new_cursor、可选: Native starttime, endtime, size, new_cursor, and optional filters
查询自建应用流程引擎审批: Get custom app workflow engine approval
自建应用审批引擎接口；发起审批需企业微信 JS-SDK thirdPartyOp: Uses the custom app Approval API; initiate approvals with WeCom JS-SDK thirdPartyOpenPage
需要配置 API 接收；数值较大的优先级优先，命中第一条即停止，回复≤2048字: Requires API reception to be configured. Higher priority numbers run first, matching stops at the first rule, and replies must not exceed 2048 bytes
查看最近接收的消息和事件: List recent incoming messages and events
最多 100 条；包括菜单和审批状态事件，原生 XML 保留扩展字段: Up to 100 records, including menu and approval status events; native XML retains extension fields
交互回调卡片更新凭证: Card update token from interaction callback
成员在网页点击自定义按钮；回传值和上下文取自服务器保存的消息，以 event_i: A member clicks a custom button on the web page; callback values and context come from the message stored on the server. Process events idempotently using event_id
发送消息时为该按钮配置的自定义 JSON 对象: The custom JSON object configured for this button when the message was sent
发送消息时保存的自定义 JSON 对象: The custom JSON object saved when the message was sent
同一消息递增，下游可据此识别乱序；不代表业务状态: Increases for each action on the same message, allowing downstream workflows to detect out-of-order events; it does not represent business state
企业微信 API 接收的普通消息，event_id 去重；原生 XML 保留图片: A regular message received through the WeCom API; deduplicate by event_id. Native XML retains fields such as images and location
包括菜单点击、进入应用、审批状态等；按 event_type 和 change_: Includes menu clicks, app entry, and approval status events; filter by event_type and change_type
